question: Can a balanced, physically trained navigation selector match the strongest fixed strategy qualification and reduce steps on new layouts, then support a smooth uninterrupted four-task sequence?

navigation_win.qualification: Selected model must meet or exceed training-selected fixed strategy on paired fresh final layouts. No relaxed physical checks.
navigation_win.efficiency: At least 5% lower mean paired-layout step count on jointly qualified attempts, with no more than 5% slower mean physical completion time. Report uncertainty and all failures.
navigation_win.selection: Development only. Final navigation opened once after checkpoint selection. Never tune against it.

training: Real Tinker LoRA updates with balanced action classes and failure examples from measured rollouts. Native gait remains fixed. Freeze the new input/action contract before comparing checkpoints.
task_goal: Six qualified continuous four-task attempts across at least three fresh task layouts, with frozen support, contact and smoothness checks. No branch splicing.
engineering: Globe approach and shared physical controllers are repaired separately, then frozen and rerun for all controls.
replay: Balance actual measured winner classes. A label requires both seeds to qualify. Preserve unlabeled failures and report unique data versus repeated presentations.
common_engineering: Preserve sampled generalized coordinates after MuJoCo constants rebuild.
Retain native whole-body arm control for navigation. The arm-masked pilot failed; one paired training-geometry diagnosis passed after restoring the native arm controller.
Preserve translation direction when bounding final-alignment velocity.
Add a 16 mm-margin fast profile with the same speed as direct and the same turn cap as buffered.
attribution: Every baseline and checkpoint shares this implementation. Engineering changes are not credited to Tinker. Old final layouts remain closed; no old final outcome is used as a fresh test.

pretraining_amendment.reason: Twelve pilot attempts failed physical qualification; restoring native arm control qualified the same training route. No Tinker optimizer updates or final evaluations preceded this amendment.
